handoff.text: Rail itself is good: my fresh build (ui6-rev-t232) vitest 27/27, scrollspy/split-view/sidebar-selection/writing 82 pass; card measured inside sidebar and clear of every .ProseMirror in continuous, page, split (both panes), unpinned overlay and floating@1600, light+dark; split pitches 12/11.8/11.5/11.7 px; role=tooltip+aria-describedby, Escape, no transition, transform-only, tokens, no fills, no new hover rule; fail-first real (ui6-t7b/failfirst.log 4 failed). REJECT only because PLAN T7b acceptance 'scrollspy -> pass' is unmet and both failures are STALE expectations in T7b's own spec, not regressions: T6 (notes/T6.md, PLAN T6 step 1, approved) made .group-label ellipsize at every width and made .entry-main small nowrap+flex-shrink:0 so the title truncates before the count. Measured at 190: 'Manuscript' label scrollWidth 71 > clientWidth 67 (text-overflow ellipsis); selected 'Frag two' semibold text 62.8px in a 50.2px span beside a 53px '0 words'. FIX (tests/scrollspy.spec.ts only): (1) (g) line 213: replace the no-overflow assert with fit-or-ellipsis, i.e. if scrollWidth > clientWidth then computed text-overflow==='ellipsis' and white-space==='nowrap' (same as T6's sidebar-selection 190 guard); rename the test (drop 'lines miss the counts'). Keep the 12-char row check and the line-inside-sidebar check. (2) (o) lines 557-570: replace 'label not ellipsized' with: label fits OR (span text-overflow ellipsis AND its first 6 characters visible) AND the row's .entry-main small is fully inside the row (count visible). Keep 'line inside the sidebar'. Say both changes in notes/T7b.md contracts list. Rerun scrollspy green. Separate, for coordinator (not required here): Research rail cards show item.detail as preview, which for notes is the note KIND (e.g. 'quote') and for sources nothing, so Research cards are not 'title + first 120 chars'; needs App.tsx collectionItems to pass note text (outside T7b's files).
